decisions.reason: The title incorrectly asserted compactness of the whole causal past: in Minkowski space it contains the unbounded past time axis. The actual Statement asserts only K_q=J^-(q) intersect J^+(Sigma), and its compactness proof is sound under CC/DC. Corrected only the title to identify that truncation.

The old proof applied the Countable-Choice-bearing global connection and normal-geodesic suppliers in clauses (a)/(b) without their hypotheses. Repaired by deriving the closed first-jet coordinate differential identity from the metric pullback equation, then proving local uniqueness by a bounded-derivative estimate and finite subdivision. Initial differential agreement now has a pointwise linear-algebra proof. The choice-free claims and Statement are preserved.

Explicitly indexed the partition by I subset {0,1,...}, halved each allowance to 2^-i/(16 sqrt(2)), and supplied the local-finiteness differentiation and triangle-inequality sum. Compact supports ensure positive ceilings and finite M_i, including M_i=0. The tube claims remain unchanged.
